title: [review] messaging.py:197: get_resources_as_linkheader ge
description: Link paths are formatted as f'/{msg_id}' which produces '/1', '/2', etc. When this resource is mounted at /msg/sent, the relative links may not resolve correctly to /msg/sent/1 depending on the base URI context. Should likely be f'/msg/sent/{msg_id}' for absolute paths, or verify aiocoap resolves relative links correctly from the resource's mount point.
